summary: Round 2 verification of Dynamo Feed player: pause-freezes-everything, reading-time-from-caption, storytime bubble-is-caption, and top-zone overlap rule. All 5 requirement families PASS at 1440x900. Deep-linked each reel via /r/:slug and scoped all DOM queries to the active feed slot (via scrollTop match) to avoid picking up windowed-neighbour reels. No app code modified.

critical_code_review_comments: ReelPlayer: `durations` is recomputed on every render and written to durationsRef. If audio metadata ever lands (currently none shipped), durationsRef mutates between ticks and elapsed may land in a different beat; harmless today but worth guarding with a useMemo if audio is enabled later.

StorytimeTemplate line 23: typing threshold uses beatDurationMs(beat, 'storytime'), but the ReelPlayer actually drives the clock with the SAME function + optional audio override. If audio durations are introduced, this threshold could drift from the real beat length. Pass the effective duration (or progress-in-ms) down from ReelPlayer rather than recomputing.

During caption-change transitions the DOM briefly renders previous beat text under the same [data-testid=reel-caption] element on r01 (BreakingNewsTemplate), making a 50ms-poll test see captions in non-monotonic order. Loop total and r03 both verify beats progress correctly, so this is purely a test-observability concern, not a product bug.

ReviewTemplate / MythVsFactTemplate rely on the outer wrapper's maxHeight+overflow:hidden to clamp growth. The inner [data-testid=review-card] element's getBoundingClientRect returns its UNCLIPPED height; QA/automation should always measure the wrapper. Consider moving the data-testid onto the overflow-hidden wrapper to make it easier to assert visible bounds.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 4 new requirement families + regressions covered this round

context_for_next_testing_agent: Always scope DOM queries to the active feed slot via `document.querySelector('[data-testid="feed-scroller"]')` + match offsetTop ≈ scrollTop — windowed ±1 rendering means [data-testid=speaker-name] / [data-testid=reel-caption] / [data-testid=character-slot] etc. have 2-3 mounted copies in the DOM at any time. For overlap checks on review/myth cards, use the PARENT of [data-testid=review-card]/[data-testid=myth-card] (the overflow-hidden wrapper with inline maxHeight) — the inner card bbox is unclipped. For bubble-vs-sprite overlap, do NOT use img.getBoundingClientRect — sprite PNGs have transparent headroom; use the computed head top from CharacterSlot's headTopPercent (100-22-heightPercent for non-waist framing). r01 BreakingNews caption readings during beat change can show stale/intermediate text in a 50-100ms window — verify beat progression via total loop time or via r03 stat_reveal instead.
